summary: Frontend-only testing of two new features completed successfully. Both features are fully functional: 1) Calculator tab editing with Edit/Cancel/Save buttons and real-time Live Price Preview, 2) Communication dialog with attachments section showing available documents as selectable buttons and Upload from Computer option.

issues: Minor console warning about chart dimensions - non-blocking
Minor accessibility warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - non-blocking

seed_data_creation: Modified existing customer 'Ramya' (RRL-00001) during testing - changed Rate from 0 to 5500 and Floor Rise to 100 to verify Save functionality. Total Value changed from ₹2,11,400 to ₹76,99,188
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two features verified working: 1) Calculator tab has Edit button that enables edit mode with Cancel/Save buttons. Fields become editable and Live Price Preview (green box) shows real-time calculations. Save persists values to customer profile. 2) Communication dialog (Email type) shows Attachments section with available documents as clickable buttons and Upload from Computer button. Documents can be selected/deselected and selection count is shown. Both features implemented in CustomerDetailPage.js.
